error_category: KeyError: uuid in legacy layout chart meta
cause_verified: Production custom layouts omit per-node UUID. Official Superset exporter retains 23 legacy nodes and appends 23 UUID-bearing chart nodes as orphan chart rows.
resolution: Inventory resolves real UUID dependency nodes; preserve original ZIP and production. Isolated restore must reconcile original layout via official REST API using UUID-ID mapping; record this additional required step.
